SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PO_NUMBER,PO_LINE_NUM,PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID, REVISION_NUM FROM UCUBE.XOIF_PUR_KEP_PO WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY PO_NUMBER,PO_LINE_NUM,PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID,REVISION_NUM
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HSDE' AS BUYER ,'KA' AS SITE , PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID , REVISION_NUM , PO_NUMBER AS LEGACY_PO_NO , DECODE(STATUS,'CANCEL','D','C') AS STATUS , DOMESTIC_OR_OVERSEA , VENDOR_SITE_ID , VENDOR_NAME , VENDOR_SITE_CODE , ITEM_ID , ITEM_NUMBER AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , UOM_CODE AS UNIT_MEASURE , ORDERED_QUANTITY AS ITEM_QTY , SHIPPED_QUANTITY , RECEIPT_QUANTITY , INVOICED_QUANTITY , ORDERED_AMOUNT AS ITEM_AMT , TAX_CODE , TAX_AMT , CURRENCY_CODE , UNIT_PRICE , AGENT_NAME , PROJECT_NO , PROJECT_NAME , TASK_NUMBER , TASK_NAME , PROJECT_CLASS , ORDERED_DATE , to_char(ORIGINAL_ORDERED_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE , to_char(NEW_PROMISE_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS RD_DATE , SHIPPED_DATE , RECEIPT_DATE , INVOICE_DATE , NEW_PROMISE_DATE , CONFIRM_DATE , ORDER_CONFIRMATION , SUPPLIER_REMARK , ENABLED_RECEIPT_DATE , RECEIPT_DAYS_EARLY , RECEIPT_DAYS_LATE , PREPAYMENT_RATE , RETAIN_RATE , PREPAYMENT_AMOUNT , RETAIN_AMOUNT , CONTRACT_STANDARD , INSURANCE_ON_CARGO , PAYMENT_TERMS , PAYMENT_METHOD , FREIGHT_TERMS , FREIGHT_CARRIER , INCOTERMS , COUNTRY_OF_ORIGIN , TO_CHAR(PO_LINE_NUM,'FM00000') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , PR_NO||'-'||PR_LINE_NO AS LEGACY_PR_NO , PR_USER_ID AS REQ_USER_ID , TRIM(PR_USER_NM) AS REQ_USER_NAME , PR_USER_TEL_NO , PR_DEPT_CODE AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , DESTINATION_TYPE , IF_FLAG , IF_DATE , ATTRIBUTE1 AS SPECIFICATION , ATTRIBUTE2 , ATTRIBUTE3 , ATTRIBUTE4 , ATTRIBUTE5 , ATTRIBUTE6 , ATTRIBUTE7 , ATTRIBUTE8 , ATTRIBUTE9 , ATTRIBUTE10 , LAST_UPDATE_DATE , LAST_UPDATED_BY , CREATION_DATE , CREATED_BY , LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN , 0 AS REVISION , ADVANCE_PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE , RETAIN_PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE , PERFORMANCE_BOND , PERFORMANCE_BOND_TYPE , MAINTENANCE_BOND , MAINTENANCE_BOND_TYPE , DELAY_RATE , DELAY_MAX_RATE , PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID || '^' || REVISION_NUM || '^' || INCOTERMS || '^' || PAYMENT_METHOD || '^' || PAYMENT_TERMS || '^' || PERFORMANCE_BOND || '^' || PERFORMANCE_BOND_TYPE || '^' || MAINTENANCE_BOND || '^' || MAINTENANCE_BOND_TYPE || '^' || DELAY_RATE || '^' || DELAY_MAX_RATE || '^' || PREPAYMENT_RATE || '^0^' || RETAIN_RATE || '^' || TO_CHAR(NEW_PROMISE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '^' || RECEIPT_DAYS_EARLY || '^' || TAX_CODE || '^' || PROJECT_NO || '^' || PROJECT_NAME || '^' || PR_DEPT_CODE || '^' || TRIM(PR_USER_NM) || '^' AS IV_COLUMN FROM UCUBE.XOIF_PUR_KEP_PO WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID = $G_RS.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID$ AND REVISION_NUM = $G_RS.REVISION_NUM$ ORDER BY PO_NUMBER, PO_LINE_NUM, PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID
UPDATE UCUBE.XOIF_PUR_KEP_PO SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID = $G_RS.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID$ AND REVISION_NUM = $G_RS.REVISION_NUM$
